name: Eulerian paths in hypergraphs and infinite graphs

insights: Euler tours in r-uniform hypergraphs are NP-complete for r≥3 (Lonc-Naroski 2010)
Locally finite infinite graphs: at most one odd-degree vertex for one-way Euler path
Chinese Postman Problem: poly for finite, may not have optimal for infinite
